verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is built for autonomous background work. Docs cover long-running tasks with no timeouts, cron-scheduled recurring tasks that can be managed from the dashboard, automatic retries with exponential backoff, waitpoints, and failure alerts. AI assistants can help set these up through the official MCP server and agent skills, and community users confirm scheduled tasks 'just work' and that it powers an AI automation platform. Missing for 10: automations must be written as TypeScript code rather than set up without code, and there is little independent hands-on evidence of AI assistants setting up automations end-to-end via MCP or skills.
